conservation.condition_narrative: The painting is unlined and maintains its original stretching and original artist’s backing board (as such, the verso is currently inaccessible). The canvas is somewhat slack with minor concavity overall. There is minor burnishing and abrasion with association small losses from the frame around the perimeter as well as local burnishing of the thread tops. The painting appears unvarnished and the darkest greens at right display a whitish efflorescence. The painting is housed in its original silver-tone thin-profile metal frame.
conservation.report_notes: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Art Institute of Chicago in 2025.
conservation.technical_description: The painting is executed on a pre-primed canvas attached to a four-member keyable stretcher with no crossbars. The work is thinly painted in a limited number of sessions, with little impasto.

(Source: Art Institute of Chicago, 2025)

description: Tall green mountains rise in the center of this landscape painting. The softly rippling mountains emerge from a flat landscape, with a strip of blue water in the foreground. Undulating white clouds stretch out above the peaks.
